Here in Dodoma the rains are short and not to be trusted, so I must be careful with money on this maize plot. I do not have schooling but I have farmed since I was a boy — I know that buying fertilizer when the rain fails is how you lose everything. I will put manure from my goats and a few cattle around the house, use seed I kept from last harvest, and work the plot with my wife and older children. If weeding gets heavy after the rains come, I will call two neighbors for a few days and pay them with food or a little money.
